## Type / 类型

- [ ] New Agent project / 新 Agent 项目
- [ ] Project continuation / 项目接续
- [ ] Reproducible report / 可复现报告
- [ ] Documentation correction / 文档修正

## Change / 改动

Project name or one focused correction. / 项目名称或一项明确修正。

## Verification / 验证

Exact commands and exit statuses. / 准确命令与退出状态。

## Handoff / 接续

For a continuation, update the same project's `HANDOFF.md`. For independent
work, create a new project directory.
接续工作更新同一项目的 `HANDOFF.md`；独立工作创建新项目目录。

## Check / 检查

- [ ] No executables, archives, dependencies, source maps, credentials, private data, or proprietary source / 未提交可执行文件、归档、依赖、source map、凭据、私有数据或专有源码
- [ ] I agree to [LICENSE](../LICENSE) / 我同意 [LICENSE](../LICENSE)
